summary: Antalpha Platform Holding Company filed a Form 6-K containing the earnings release of its subsidiary Aurelion Inc. for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The release reports Aurelion's net asset value (NAV) of $91.9 million ($2.44 per share) and an operating loss of $24.4 million driven by gold depreciation. No terms of a transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or special-situation event are present. The filing is a routine disclosure of financial results by a foreign private issuer. There is no reportable special situation.
